action.assignFootprint: Place on a team and quarter
app.name: Flowmap
attention.description: These items need a human look now. Health is a different question — a healthy commitment can still need attention.
attention.title: Attention
capacitySettings.description: Reserves are the part of a quarter that is already spoken for. What is left is deliverable capacity, and every utilisation figure on the board is measured against it.
capacitySettings.label: Label for {type}
capacitySettings.overReserved: {reserved} reserved of {capacity}: more than the quarter has
capacitySettings.quartersNote: The figures the board is actually computed from. A quarter keeps whatever it was seeded with until you change it here.
capacitySettings.retrofit: Also write these onto {name}'s {count} open quarters
capacitySettings.retrofit.one: Also write these onto {name}'s {count} open quarter
capacitySettings.title: Capacity
capacitySettings.workspaceNote: What a new team-quarter starts from, for every team that has not overridden it.
capture.unplannedHint: Arrived mid-quarter. Captured, placed, and committed in one step — never straight into delivery.
confirm.clearLocalData: This deletes the local copy of this workspace. Type the workspace name to confirm.
consequence.apply: Applying this scenario creates a snapshot and clears undo history.
consequence.label: Consequence preview
dependencyMap.description: Waiting work is on the left. Prerequisites sit further right. Each column is one step along the chain. Solid lines are hard dependencies; dashed lines are soft.
dependencyMap.descriptionFor: {name} is required by {count} commitments. {unresolved} remain unresolved.
dependencyMap.hubMeaning: A hub is a commitment, decision, or team that three or more items are waiting on. It is not a priority ranking. Example: a security review required by six commitments.
dependencyMap.title: Dependency map
drop.alsoTaken: {team} also picks up {name} in {quarter}, taking {units} units.
drop.blockHint: Drag a block onto another team and it is picked up there as well. Hold Alt to move it instead.
drop.carrying: Carrying {name}. Arrow keys choose a team and quarter, Enter drops, Escape cancels.
drop.confirm.body: Dropping is a decision not to take this work. It leaves demand and does not consume capacity.
drop.confirm.title: Drop {name}
drop.no.DUPLICATE_FOOTPRINT: this work already has a block here
drop.no.LINK_NEEDS_WORK: there is no work here to depend on
drop.no.MANDATORY_NEEDS_TARGET_DATE: mandatory work needs a target date before it can be committed
drop.no.NOT_MATERIALISED: this team has no capacity set for that quarter yet
drop.railHint: Drag onto a quarter to place. Space picks up, arrows aim, Enter drops.
drop.wouldAlsoTake: {team} would also pick up {name} in {quarter} at {units} units, taking it to {percent}%. Alt moves it here instead.
drop.wouldLand: {name} would land on {team} {quarter}, taking it to {percent}%.
drop.wouldMove: {name} would move to {team} {quarter}, taking it to {percent}%.
empty.board.body: Capture an idea, then place it on a team and quarter to see capacity respond.
empty.board.title: Nothing placed yet
empty.ideas.body: Capture anything that might consume real capacity. A title is enough to start.
empty.ideas.title: No ideas captured
empty.teams.body: Add the teams whose capacity you plan — usually 4 to 8 to start.
empty.teams.title: No teams yet
error.boundary.body: Your data is safe on disk. Reload to continue, or export diagnostics if this keeps happening.
error.boundary.title: Flowmap hit an unexpected error
firstRun.definition: Capture an idea, then place it on a team and quarter to see its capacity consequence.
firstRun.example: Example: capture a new client commitment, place its expected capacity, then use the Radar to review the pressure it creates.
firstRun.not: This is not a task board: Flowmap shows management-level demand and constraints.
firstRun.sampleHint: The sample portfolio is always in the workspace switcher. Opening it leaves this empty workspace as it is.
firstRun.title: Start with the portfolio landscape
gate.advisories: Worth checking, though none of these will stop you:
gate.label: Commit Gate for {name}
gate.overflow: Committing this leaves a quarter {units} units over capacity. That is allowed — it is a decision, not an error.
gate.title: Commit Gate
health.label: Health
history.closeNotice: This cannot be undone. A snapshot is created first and capacity containers become immutable.
history.description: History explains what changed; it never restores data.
history.noEvents: No management changes have been recorded yet.
history.title: History and quarter close
link.hint: Shift-drag from a block, or press d, to draw a dependency.
link.needsWork: Point at a piece of work — a dependency is between two things, not a container.
list.caption: Capacity footprints. Totals match the visual exactly.
map.focused: Focused: {name}. {footprints} footprints across {teams} teams and {quarters} quarters.
map.focusedRelations: Focused: {name}. {footprints} footprints across {teams} teams and {quarters} quarters. {products} products, {milestones} milestones, {dependencies} dependencies.
map.label: Portfolio map. {teams} teams across {quarters} quarters. Arrow keys to move.
notifications.blocked: Notifications are blocked. Signals remain available in Radar.
notifications.title: Flowmap attention
order.atEnd: Already at the end of the stack.
order.moved: {name} moved to position {position} in the stack.
order.would: {name} would take {other}'s place in the stack
palette.empty: No exact local match. Flowmap does not interpret natural language.
palette.placeholder: Search, + idea <title>, > go to team, filter: quarter 2027-Q1
palette.title: Command palette
panel.label: Details for {name}
panel.linkOpenFailed: Could not open that link. Copy the address instead: {url}
panel.linkTypeLabel: Which system this link points at
panel.milestoneCap: Six is the limit — this list is a summary, not a plan.
panel.milestonePlaceholder: What has to be true, and by when?
panel.notPlaced: Not placed on the board yet
panel.notePlaceholder: Context for whoever picks this up next
panel.outcomePlaceholder: What will be true once this is done?
panel.personOwnerHint: People are not editable yet — teams only
panel.primaryTeamHint: Set by dropping this work on a team
panel.splitNowhere: Nothing to split into — this work sits in one quarter with 1 unit.
panel.unknownPerson: Someone no longer in this workspace
portability.definition: Export a current view or a complete workspace, then preview supported CSV, JSON, or XLSX files before importing.
portability.duplicatesNeedReview: Possible duplicates need review before import. Flowmap does not merge them automatically.
portability.example: Example: export a workspace after a quarter review, then recover it on another device.
portability.field.name: Name
portability.importNewer: This package was written by a newer version of Flowmap and cannot be read.
portability.importNotAWorkspace: That JSON is not a workspace export — it has no workspace and no entities in it.
portability.importNothing: Nothing in {name} could be read as rows to import.
portability.importUnreadable: Flowmap could not read this file. Choose a CSV, JSON, or XLSX file.
portability.importedWorkspace: Imported {name}. It opened as a workspace of its own.
portability.not: This does not connect Flowmap to a project-management system or silently merge matching names.
portability.previewSummary: Preview: {creates} new, {updates} updates, {duplicates} possible duplicates, {errors} errors.
portability.sensitivity: This file contains your portfolio's management data in plain text. Store and share it according to your organisation's data classification.
portability.title: Move portfolio data safely
presentation.off: Presentation mode off. Editing controls are available again.
presentation.on: Presentation mode on. Editing controls are hidden. Press Escape to exit.
products.description: Team capacity answers ‘can we deliver it’. Change load answers ‘where does the change land’.
products.noChange: No committed change in this horizon.
products.title: Products and services
qbr.cell: {team}, {quarter}. {committed} committed, {carry} carried over, {ghost} new demand, of {capacity} deliverable.
qbr.description: What happens if we accept this demand? Ideas stay off the board until Commit Gate. Carry-over and new demand stay separate.
qbr.gateDescription: The Idea stays tentative until the scenario is applied.
qbr.label: Demand Flow
qbr.moveMode: Move mode. Arrow keys choose a team and quarter. Enter places the ghost footprint. Escape cancels.
qbr.pipeEmpty: Choose an Idea to size and place it in a scenario.
qbr.scenarioRequired: Create and select a scenario before placing demand.
qbr.summaryGhost: {units} units of new demand in the scenario
qbr.title: QBR
radar.emptyMine: Nothing assigned to you needs attention. Portfolio may still have items.
radar.hidden: {count} reviewed or deferred, hidden until something changes
radar.hidden.one: {count} reviewed or deferred, hidden until something changes
radar.label: Radar
radar.noTarget: That signal has nothing to open — the detail is in its facts.
radar.order: Grouped by reason, in a fixed order of {groups} groups.
radar.reviewedNote: Reviewed. It returns if the situation changes or worsens.
radar.snoozedUntil: Deferred until {date}. It returns sooner if this gets worse.
recovery.corruptCache: The local cache could not be read and was reset. Import a workspace export or open the sample workspace from the switcher to continue.
recurrence.title: Recurrence
remove.hint: Drag a block here to take it off the board, or press Delete on it.
remove.no.IDEA_NOT_PLACED: it is not on the board yet
remove.no.NOT_REVERTIBLE: work past the Commit Gate cannot go back to the lane; only committed work can be returned to demand
remove.refused: Cannot take this off the board — {reason}.
remove.wouldUnplace: Take {units} units of {name} off this quarter
resize.grip: Drag to change how much of the quarter {name} takes
resize.refused: Cannot resize — that quarter is closed.
sample.loaded: Sample workspace loaded: {teams} teams, {commitments} commitments, {ideas} ideas.
savedViews.definition: A saved view remembers the active lens and filters for this workspace.
savedViews.example: Example: save Capacity watch to return to this quarter's teams and lifecycle filters.
savedViews.name: View name
savedViews.not: It does not copy portfolio data or create a separate workspace.
savedViews.title: Save this view
scenario.applyDescription: Apply all changes to the baseline. This creates a snapshot and clears undo history.
scenario.baselineStatus: Baseline is the committed portfolio. Create a scenario to explore a change without altering it.
scenario.draftStatus: Draft changes stay separate from the baseline until you apply them.
scenario.label: Scenario workspace
scenario.presentationBlocked: Exit presentation mode to change the portfolio.
scenario.rebase.conflict: Overlaps with a baseline change to {field}
scenario.rebaseDescription: The baseline changed. Resolve overlapping changes before applying.
scenario.selectiveDescription: Choose only the planning changes to apply. Required earlier changes are included when needed.
settings.clear.body: This removes the local cache for the current workspace and reloads an empty one. Export a .flowmap file first if you need the work.
settings.clear.title: Clear local data
settings.filePropagation: Changes appear for others after each save and may take a few minutes to propagate.
settings.mode.browserNote: This is the development and demo target. Data is stored in this browser, not a folder. The desktop build is what ships.
settings.mode.portableBeside: Portable — using the data folder beside the app.
settings.outOfRange: {value} is outside the permitted range of {min} to {max}.
settings.portableHow: To run fully portable, create a folder named data beside Flowmap.exe or Flowmap.app. Flowmap keeps workspaces and logs there and leaves nothing in the user profile. Secrets stay in the OS keychain and are never copied into that folder.
settings.portableHow.browser: Portable folders exist only in the desktop build.
settings.rolesAdvisory: Flowmap does not verify who you are. Names on changes are self-declared, and roles here prevent accidents rather than enforce permissions. Access to this workspace is controlled entirely by who can reach the shared file.
settings.rulesNote: Rules are deterministic and code-defined. You can tune what they compare against and how loudly they speak, and switch advisory ones off. Nothing here is learned or scored.
settings.title: Settings
settings.webview.missingHint: If Flowmap will not start on another Windows machine, use Flowmap-{version}-win-x64-standalone.zip. That build includes the WebView2 runtime.
shortcuts.escape: Clear focus, cancel a mode, or leave presentation
shortcuts.gate: Open Commit Gate for the focused Idea
shortcuts.moveInstead: Move the placement instead of having this team take it on too
shortcuts.moveMode: Move mode — arrows choose a target, Enter commits, Esc cancels
shortcuts.moveSelection: Move selection between cells and blocks
shortcuts.regions: Move between the lane, the grid, and the panel
shortcuts.reorder: Move the focused block up or down its stack, choosing what sits above the rule
shortcuts.span: Run the work across one more quarter, or one fewer
shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
snapshot.confirm: Type the recovery point action to confirm
snapshot.confirmationRequired: Type the recovery point action exactly before restoring it.
snapshot.definition: A recovery point records this workspace before a major change or when you create one.
snapshot.example: Example: create a recovery point before importing a planning file.
snapshot.not: It is not a shared backup and does not replace an exported workspace.
snapshot.title: Recovery points
snapshot.unsupported: This recovery point cannot be restored by this version of Flowmap.
span.grip: Drag to run {name} across more quarters, or fewer
span.no.CLOSED_QUARTER: Cannot reach into a closed quarter — that one is settled.
span.no.NOT_MATERIALISED: Cannot reach there — that team has no capacity set for the quarter yet.
span.no.OUTSIDE_HORIZON: Cannot reach past the end of the horizon.
span.wouldReach: {name} would run across {count} quarters, taking {units} more
span.wouldReach.one: {name} would run across {count} quarter, taking {units} more
span.wouldRetract: {name} would run across {count} quarters, giving back {units}
span.wouldRetract.one: {name} would run across {count} quarter, giving back {units}
sync.conflict.def: The same field changed locally and on the shared document since the last successful write.
sync.conflict.eg: You renamed a commitment and a colleague changed the same name — both values stay until you pick one.
sync.conflict.label: Sync conflict
sync.conflict.not: a merge Flowmap will guess at. Overlapping edits wait for an explicit choice.
sync.conflictsLead: These fields changed in two places. Choose yours, theirs, or type a merged value. Nothing is overwritten silently.
sync.readOnly: The shared file is read-only. Local work is kept.
sync.shared.def: A versioned .flowmap document in a folder the team can already reach. Flowmap writes it atomically after a version check.
sync.shared.eg: A file named portfolio.flowmap sitting in a SharePoint library the leads already use.
sync.shared.label: Shared workspace
sync.shared.not: a live server, a shared SQLite file, or instant sync. Peers see changes after the folder client propagates the file.
sync.vanished: The shared file is gone from this folder. Local work is kept and can be exported.
team.archive.body: Archiving hides this team from the map. Undo restores it. A team that still holds work cannot be archived.
team.archive.title: Archive {name}
team.archiveBlocked: {team} still has work on the board. Move or remove its footprints first.
teams.description: Team capacity answers ‘can we take this’. Portfolio answers ‘what is committed’.
teams.empty: No teams have been added yet.
teams.filtered: No teams match the current filters.
teams.title: Teams
themes.description: Themes are deliberate groupings that make shared direction visible. They are not delivery plans.
themes.empty: No themes have been defined yet.
themes.name: Theme
themes.title: Themes
timeline.description: Footprints are shown as fragments. This is not a delivery schedule.
timeline.title: Timeline
tooltip.size.definition: Approximate relative capacity for this team and quarter.
tooltip.size.example: For example: work that would occupy about a third of one team's quarter.
tooltip.size.isNot: It is not a story-point or person-day estimate.
tooltip.size.title: Size: {size}
tradeoff.label: Capacity trade-offs
tradeoff.none: No other work in this overflow is available to move.
tradeoff.reason.HARD_DEPENDENCY: An open hard dependency constrains it
undo.refused: That change can no longer be undone: {reason}
workspace.archiveNeedsAnother: Create another workspace before archiving this one.
workspace.archiveSampleBlocked: The sample workspace stays available. Archive a workspace you created instead.
workspace.location.fileHint: Changes appear for others after each save and may take a few minutes to propagate.
workspace.name: Workspace name
workspace.role.def: A self-declared role that shapes what Flowmap lets you do, so a Viewer cannot accidentally move committed work.
workspace.role.eg: A Planner can apply a scenario; a Viewer can still read the same board.
workspace.role.label: Workspace role
workspace.role.not: a verified identity or a security boundary. The shared folder's permissions decide who can open the file.
